The team reviewed client updates, including Ahmed's 15 positive LinkedIn replies for Shopper Group and the necessity for diligent follow-ups on previous leads. Ahmed was promoted to Associate for his improved negotiation skills, prompting updates to his title on the company website. Action items were assigned, including sending teasers, following up on NDAs, and scheduling calls with various clients, ensuring accountability and progress as the team moves forward.
summary.short_summary: The M&A catch-up meeting concentrated on the onboarding of three new companies: Query Click, Xtema, and Web Instinct. Andrew highlighted the necessity of implementing a nominal fee of $2,500 for listings to attract serious buyers, expressing frustration over free listings lacking conversion. Client updates revealed that Ahmed received 15 positive LinkedIn replies for Shopper Group, necessitating the sending of teasers, along with the need for diligent follow-ups on previous leads like Cool company and Zef Davis. The client pipeline review included ongoing NDA processes with varied responses and potential offers from On Design. Ahmed was promoted to Associate due to his improved negotiation skills, which Andrew acknowledged. Action items were assigned to ensure progress, including sending teasers, following up on NDAs, and scheduling calls with clients.
